nodes.name: Floor 3 Landing
nodes.visual_signature: Wide glass-panelled double door at the top of the main staircase, brass 'MAIN BLOCK - FLOOR 3' plate on the left jamb, green running-man fire exit sign overhead, notice board covered in orange flyers immediately inside

nodes.name: Corridor C West
nodes.visual_signature: Corridor with cream walls and a red terrazzo stripe down the middle of the floor, blue steel lockers along the right wall, a short flight of steps rising to the north stair landing on the left, Lab 302 door on the right

nodes.name: Corridor C Middle
nodes.visual_signature: Corridor junction directly outside the lift lobby, stainless steel lift doors on the north side, red fire hose reel cabinet mounted on the wall between Lab 303 and the lift, ceiling fan hanging at the junction

nodes.name: Corridor C East
nodes.visual_signature: East end of the corridor with a tall grilled window at the far wall looking onto the parking lot, heavy wooden Seminar Hall doors on the right, ramp with a yellow painted handrail rising to the north gallery on the left

nodes.name: North Gallery
nodes.visual_signature: Half-level gallery running behind the lift shaft, open railing on one side looking down onto Corridor C, framed convocation photographs in a row along the opposite wall, tube lights end to end

nodes.name: North Stairs
nodes.visual_signature: Short flight of eight steps with chipped granite nosings and a painted iron handrail, 'NO PARKING OF CYCLES' stencilled in black on the side wall, landing turns right toward the north gallery

nodes.name: Lift A
nodes.visual_signature: Single stainless steel lift door with a scratched call panel and one lit call button, floor indicator showing 3 in red seven-segment digits, blue plate above the door reading 'LIFT A - 6 PERSONS / 408 KG'

nodes.name: Lab 302
nodes.visual_signature: Blue double door, 'LAB 302' sign on the right at head height, fire extinguisher on the left wall, lift visible about 15m down the corridor

nodes.name: Lab 303
nodes.visual_signature: Grey single door usually propped open with a wooden wedge, an A4 sheet reading 'LAB 303 - NETWORKS' taped to the glass panel, rows of beige desktop monitors visible inside, whiteboard with a faded network diagram on the back wall

nodes.name: Seminar Hall
nodes.visual_signature: Pair of heavy teak doors with round brass handles, maroon curtain visible through the gap between them, 'SEMINAR HALL' in gold letters on a dark green board above the frame, tiered seating and a ceiling mounted projector inside

nodes.name: North Washroom
nodes.visual_signature: Recessed doorway off the north gallery with a blue and white pictogram sign screwed to the wall beside it, white glazed wall tiles visible through the doorway, floor mop and bucket usually parked to the left of the entrance

nodes.name: Faculty Room 3A
nodes.visual_signature: Brown laminated door with a frosted glass panel, a printed strip beside the handle listing four faculty names, a 'PLEASE KNOCK' card taped below it, potted money plant on a wooden stool outside

equipment.name: GPU Workstation 7
equipment.visual_signature: black tower PC with orange fans, on the bench nearest the window
equipment.manual_snippet: Before use: log in with your lab ID. Check GPU temperature is under 60C. Do not run jobs longer than 4h without booking.

equipment.name: Core Switch Rack B
equipment.visual_signature: half height grey 9U rack against the back wall, bundle of yellow patch cables looping out of the top, row of green link LEDs
equipment.manual_snippet: Do not unplug uplink ports 23 and 24 - they carry the department VLAN. Console access is via the blue rollover cable on the shelf. Log any port change in the register kept on top of the rack.

equipment.name: Seminar Hall Projector
equipment.visual_signature: white ceiling mounted projector on a black drop pole above the third row of seats, HDMI wall plate on the pillar below it
equipment.manual_snippet: Input select is on the wall plate, not the remote. Allow 90 seconds for lamp warm up. Always power down through the remote and wait for the fan to stop before switching off the mains.

observations.evidence: Three stacked chairs and a folded banquet table block the full width of the corridor outside the lift lobby; the fire hose reel cabinet is visible behind them.
The east stretch of the corridor is clear end to end, with the grilled window visible at the far wall and nothing on the floor.
